testcase.name: Third consecutive failure disables the style at once; its remaining points in the tick are skipped
All styles disabled: the planner skips the ring as unsupported before evaluation; a new session re-enables
Successes of another style do not reset the streak; the streak spans ticks
A success of the same style resets the streak: fail, fail, succeed, fail, fail does not disable
The next planning pass excludes the disabled style: M6 reports it unsupported, nothing of it is sent
